title: How to Add Google Analytics and Other Tracking Codes to Your Divi Website
raw_text:
How to Add Google Analytics and Other Tracking Codes to Your Divi Website
## Overview
Tracking your website’s performance is crucial for understanding visitor behavior, measuring the effectiveness of your content, and making informed decisions to improve your site.
This guide is perfect for website owners, marketers, and developers who want to enhance their site’s analytics capabilities and gain deeper insights into their audience and performance.
Whether you want to track traffic, conversions, or user interactions, our step-by-step instructions will show you how to integrate these tracking codes seamlessly.
• Go toWordPress Dashboard→Divi → Theme Option → Integration tab
• For tracking scripts such as Google Analytics or Facebook Pixel, place the related scripts in theAdd code to the < body > (good for tracking codes such as Google Analytics)section
Go to WordPress Dashboard → Divi → Theme Option → Integration tab
For tracking scripts such as Google Analytics or Facebook Pixel, place the related scripts in the Add code to the < body > (good for tracking codes such as Google Analytics ) section
Note : Make sure that the Enable body code option is enabled:
